content:
Latest references discovered in the WhatsApp TestFlight version show that Meta is working on providing iPhone users with an alternative to iCloud backup. Here are the details.

WhatsApp is developing its own backup service

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is developing its own cloud backup service for iPhone users as an alternative to iCloud.

The feature has not yet been opened to WhatsApp TestFlight users, but WABetaInfo successfully activated an interface that allows users to choose a backup location between iCloud and WhatsApp's own cloud service. The interface shows 2GB of free storage space, and the report indicates that paid plans can offer up to 1TB.

The report also mentions that users can choose whether WhatsApp backups on iCloud should use end-to-end encryption, but for WhatsApp's own backup system, end-to-end encryption will be the default setting.

Although the official launch time of the feature has not yet been determined, the report points out that WhatsApp is also developing a Google Drive backup alternative for Android users. Given that development work on both platforms is proceeding simultaneously, this feature may be officially announced soon.
